slides.subtitle: Sahara Solar turns unused commercial rooftops in the Gulf into income-generating solar assets — with zero upfront cost to building owners.
slides.notes: Open with the one-liner. Do not read the slide; it is a visual anchor.

slides.title: What we'll cover in 15 minutes

steps.head: The problem: wasted rooftops, rising tariffs

slides.notes: Promise the arc in 20 seconds: problem, solution, market proof, ask.

slides.title: Gulf rooftops sit empty while power bills climb

items.head: 92% of commercial roofs generate nothing
items.body: Warehouses and malls pay full grid tariffs under 3,000+ hours of sun.

items.head: Tariffs rose 38% in five years
items.body: Energy is now the #2 operating cost in logistics and retail.

items.head: Capex blocks adoption
items.body: Owners refuse 7-figure upfront spend and maintenance risk.

slides.notes: Land the pain with one story: a warehouse owner paying full tariff under empty sun. Pause after the 38% figure.

slides.subtitle: We finance, install and operate the panels. Owners simply buy cheaper power.
slides.notes: Section beat. One sentence: we remove every barrier — money, risk, operations.

slides.title: Solar-as-a-service, end to end

items.head: Zero capex
items.body: We fund 100% against a 15-year power agreement.

items.head: 25% cheaper power
items.body: Per-kWh pricing at a fixed discount from day one.

items.head: Live dashboard
items.body: Generation, savings and CO2 reporting for ESG.

items.head: Carbon credits
items.body: Credits aggregated; 30% of proceeds shared with owners.

items.head: Bankable contracts
items.body: Standard PPAs cleared by two regional lenders.

slides.notes: Walk the six tiles left-to-right, top row then bottom. Each tile = one objection removed.

steps.head: Survey
steps.body: Drone scan and structural check within one week of signing.

steps.head: Finance
